I3Locate.//: All values may also be supplied via environment variables, e.g. I3Locate__GoogleGeolocationApiKey. Environment variables win over this file.
I3Locate.//GoogleGeolocationApiKey: Optional. Enables precise Wi-Fi triangulation via the Google Geolocation API (https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/geolocation). When empty, I3Locate falls back to coarse IP-based location, so it still reports a position without a key.
I3Locate.//IpInfoToken: Optional ipinfo.io token. Raises rate limits and is used for the IP-based location fallback and network ownership lookup.
I3Locate.//OutputDirectory: Where the report and captured images are written for the RMM to collect. Empty means %ProgramData%\I3Locate.
I3Locate.//WebhookUrl: Optional. When set, the JSON report is POSTed here in addition to being written to disk (e.g. an RMM ingest endpoint or a private webhook).
